hero.headline: Eye exams, contacts, frames
hero.sub: Malvern Vision Care is an optometry practice on West King Street. The work they publish is eye exams, contacts, and frames. You come to see, you leave with a prescription, contacts, or a pair of frames from that office. Hours are left blank because sources disagree.

items.title: Eye exams
items.text: An eye exam is the start of the chart. Malvern Vision Care is an optometry office, so the exam is the skilled work, not a glasses vending machine with a poster.

items.title: Contacts
items.text: Contacts are a published service. The same practice that does the exam can fit and supply contacts, so the prescription does not have to leave town to become a lens.

items.title: Frames
items.text: Frames are the third published piece. You can take the exam and choose frames in the same Malvern office on West King Street.

story.heading: West King Street optometry
paragraphs: Malvern Vision Care keeps a short, honest list: eye exams, contacts, frames. That is enough to run an optometry practice. This page will not invent a specialty clinic, a pediatric program, or a set of hours the sources cannot agree on.

A visit is an exam first. Contacts and frames are how the exam becomes something you wear. 32 W King St is the office. 610-644-1879 is the phone. The rest of a vision-care novel can wait until their site and the aggregators tell the same story. Malvern Vision Care is optometry with those three published services, and nothing extra invented for the brief.

experience.heading: How an optometry visit actually moves

items.title: Sit for the eye exam
items.text: The exam is the medical work. Malvern Vision Care starts there, as an optometry practice, not as a frame shop that happens to have a chart.

items.title: Fit contacts when that is the path
items.text: Contacts are on their list. If the prescription is for lenses you wear on the eye, the same office can handle that path.

items.title: Choose frames in the same office
items.text: Frames are the third published service. Exam and frames can be one Malvern visit on West King Street.

feature.heading: Three words of optometry
feature.text: Eye exams. Contacts. Frames. Malvern Vision Care is that practice on West King Street. No extra departments invented for the brief. An exam can become contacts or frames in the same Malvern office, which is the whole published path.

spotlight.heading: Hours stay off this page
spotlight.text: Sources disagree on the clock, so the clock is empty. The services are not in dispute: eye exams, contacts, and frames, from the Malvern office.
